title: 04 Freelance Service Contract & Contract for Work - Topic Quiz

questions.text: How does a Freelance Service Contract fundamentally differ from a Regular Employment Contract?
options: The freelance worker is not bound by instructions, fixed working hours, or workplace
The freelance worker is legally required to supply their own work equipment
The freelance worker registers independently with the SVS
The freelance worker receives paid vacation and special payments
questions.correctAnswer: The freelance worker is not bound by instructions, fixed working hours, or workplace

questions.text: Who provides the work equipment under a Freelance Service Contract and who registers the worker with the OeGK?
options: The freelance worker uses own equipment and registers with the OeGK
The employer provides the work equipment and registers the worker with the OeGK
The employer provides the work equipment and registers the worker with the SVS
The freelance worker uses own equipment and the employer registers with the SVS
questions.correctAnswer: The employer provides the work equipment and registers the worker with the OeGK

questions.text: Johannes Hackl redesigns the Sport4U GmbH website at home on his own laptop for a EUR 12,000.00 fee payable upon defect-free completion. Which contract applies?
options: Regular Employment Contract
Freelance Service Contract
Contract for Work
Marginal Employment Contract

questions.text: With which social insurance institution must a contractor under a Contract for Work register independently in Austria?
options: With the OeGK for health and unemployment insurance
With the tax office via monthly wage tax deduction
With the AUVA exclusively for accident insurance
With the SVS for health, pension, and accident insurance
questions.correctAnswer: With the SVS for health, pension, and accident insurance

questions.text: Lisa Wenig writes three regional articles per week for Kronen Zeitung on an ongoing basis with free choice of time and place and no instructions. Which contract applies?
options: Contract for Work
Freelance Service Contract
Regular Employment Contract
Mandatory Internship

questions.text: Thea Brandt builds a customer database for AT&S for EUR 18,900.00 payable on completion. May she delegate parts of the work to a programmer friend?
options: No, because she must perform all work strictly in person
Only if AT&S first registers the friend with the OeGK
Yes, because there is no personal duty; she remains liable for warranty
Yes, and full warranty liability transfers immediately to AT&S
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, because there is no personal duty; she remains liable for warranty

questions.text: How do both freelance service workers and contractors pay income tax to the tax office?
options: Independently by filing an income tax return
Automatically through wage tax deducted by the client
Through monthly deductions processed by the OeGK
Not at all as long as fees remain below EUR 20,000.00
questions.correctAnswer: Independently by filing an income tax return

questions.text: Neither freelance service workers nor contractors are entitled to paid vacation, sick pay, or special payments.
Just like a contractor under a Contract for Work, a freelance service worker bears the full economic risk.
Compare the Freelance Service Contract and the Contract for Work by naming two similarities and three clear differences.
questions.correctAnswer: Similarities: no personal dependency (free in time, place, and instructions), no paid vacation, sick pay, or special payments, and self-taxation via income tax return. Differences: (1) Object: ongoing labor vs. a concrete finished result; (2) Equipment and risk: employer supplies equipment and bears risk vs. contractor uses own equipment, bears own economic risk, and has warranty liability; (3) Social insurance: employer registers with OeGK vs. contractor registers independently with SVS.
